description: This file implements functions for managing a list of strings, including initialization, insertion, removal, searching, sorting, splitting, and other utilities related to string list management. It is part of a larger project, likely related to git, given included headers.

methods.name: void string_list_init_nodup(struct string_list * list)
methods.description: Initializes a string list without duplicating the strings, setting it to a predefined empty state.

methods.name: void string_list_init_dup(struct string_list * list)
methods.description: Initializes a string list with duplication enabled, setting it to a predefined empty state.

methods.name: struct:string_list_item * string_list_insert(struct string_list * list,const char * string)
methods.description: Inserts a string into the list, maintaining sorted order, and returns the inserted item.

methods.name: void string_list_remove(struct string_list * list,const char * string,int free_util)
methods.description: Removes a string from the list, free existing memory if required.

methods.name: bool string_list_has_string(const struct string_list * list,const char * string)
methods.description: Checks whether the list contains a given string.

methods.name: size_t string_list_find_insert_index(const struct string_list * list,const char * string,bool * exact_match)
methods.description: Finds the index where a string could be inserted to maintain sorted order, and whether it's an exact match.

methods.name: struct:string_list_item * string_list_lookup(struct string_list * list,const char * string)
methods.description: Looks up a string in the list and returns its item if found.

methods.name: void string_list_remove_duplicates(struct string_list * list,int free_util)
methods.description: Removes duplicate entries from the list.

methods.name: int for_each_string_list(struct string_list * list,string_list_each_func_t fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Iterates over all items in the list, applying a callback function.

methods.name: void filter_string_list(struct string_list * list,int free_util,string_list_each_func_t want,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Filters items in the list based on a callback, optionally freeing certain data.

methods.name: void string_list_remove_empty_items(struct string_list * list,int free_util)
methods.description: Removes items with empty strings from the list.

methods.name: void string_list_clear(struct string_list * list,int free_util)
methods.description: Frees all items and resets the list.

methods.name: void string_list_clear_func(struct string_list * list,string_list_clear_func_t clearfunc)
methods.description: Frees all items and applies a custom cleanup function.

methods.name: void string_list_setlen(struct string_list * list,size_t nr)
methods.description: Manually sets the length of the list, used with caution.

methods.name: struct:string_list_item * string_list_append(struct string_list * list,const char * string)
methods.description: Appends a string to the list, duplicating the string if configured.

methods.name: struct:string_list_item * string_list_append_nodup(struct string_list * list,char * string)
methods.description: Appends an existing string pointer to the list without duplicating.

methods.name: void string_list_sort(struct string_list * list)
methods.description: Sorts the list using the installed comparison function.
